author: Shudhanshu Singh
attribution: Derived from A-Z Medicine Dataset of India by Shudhanshu Singh on Kaggle, CC BY-SA 4.0.
source_price_reference_date: November 2022 (according to the dataset description); not current prices

field_mapping.type: Inferred from medicine-name keywords; source type is allopathy, not dosage form.
field_mapping.extra: Tablet: source tablets per pack; Syrup: source bottle ml; Injection: integer mg strength from name or single composition.
field_mapping.manufacturer_name: Preserved in the source subset, not treated as a real inventory supplier.
field_mapping.inventory_id: Local numeric IDs 101-600; source_subset.inventory_id maps back to the original Kaggle id.

changes: Selected 500 distinct names across tablets, syrups and injections, excluding entries marked discontinued at source snapshot time.
Kept only positive finite source prices and products with a supported integer pack-size/strength field.
Normalized inventory names to ASCII and removed CSV commas/newlines; original names remain in the source subset.
Generated reproducible demo inventory values with seed 24 and reference date 2026-10-27.
The existing Java subclasses add demonstration packaging charges to the source base prices when displaying prices.
usage_note: Educational inventory demo only. Stock, expiry and supplier records are invented, not real batch data. Not for clinical decisions or actual dispensing.
